# CrossAgent Lab

> 别人正在用的跨境 Agent 做法。偷一个灵感。
> Real things sellers do with AI agents. Steal an idea.

CrossAgent Lab (https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com) is a public directory of cross-border AI-agent workflows: listing, ads, support, ops, and logistics for sellers on Amazon, Shopify, and similar channels. Each case is summarized in our own words from a public source, links to that source, and includes a reusable prompt. Audience: cross-border operators and people building agents for them.

## Key URLs

- Home: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/
- Sponsor / pricing: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/sponsor/
- Submit a use case: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/submit/
- Cases: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/cases/{slug}/
- Guide — Amazon Seller MCP & Ads Agents for Cross-Border Sellers: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/guides/amazon-seller-mcp-cross-border/
- Newsletter: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/newsletter/
- About: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/about/
- RSS: https://crossagent.maoxunxing.com/rss.xml
